nodes.summary: For a bitstring $x$: if $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding, to a pair $(u, \varphi)$ of a bitstring $u$ of length $m$ and a DNF formula $\varphi$ all of whose literals have variables less than $m$, the value at $x$ is the number of assignments of booleans to the variables $0, \dots, m - 1$ that satisfy $\varphi$; otherwise the value is $0$.
nodes.title: Number of satisfying assignments of an encoded DNF formula

nodes.summary: A DNF formula is a list of terms, each a list of literals $(v, b)$ of a natural number $v$ (the variable) and a boolean $b$ (the polarity). An assignment $a$ of booleans to the natural numbers satisfies the formula when some term of it has $a(v) = b$ for every literal $(v, b)$ of that term.
nodes.title: Satisfaction of a DNF formula

nodes.summary: For a bitstring $x$, let $N(x)$ be the number of satisfying assignments of the DNF formula encoded by $x$: if $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding, to a pair $(u, \varphi)$ of a bitstring $u$ of length $m$ and a DNF formula $\varphi$ whose variables are all less than $m$, then $N(x)$ is the number of assignments of booleans to the variables $0, \dots, m - 1$ that satisfy $\varphi$, and otherwise…

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
